definitions.gloss: trial calculation; preliminary estimate; tentative computation
definitions.explanation: a preliminary calculation made to check or estimate figures before making a final determination; often used in business and financial planning

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{試算|しさん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧みた。
examples.english: I did a preliminary cost calculation.

examples.japanese: {試算|しさん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{一億円|いちおくえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: According to preliminary calculations, it would result in annual savings of 100 million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済効果|けいざいこうか}→経済効果：27193_keizaikouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{試算|しさん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The government calculated a preliminary estimate of the economic impact.

notes:
FORMS:
{試|し} (trial, test) + {算|さん} (calculation) → trial calculation

CAN FUNCTION AS:
- Noun: {試算|しさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to conduct a trial calculation)
- Suru-verb: {試算|しさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a trial calculation)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {試算|しさん}{表|ひょう} (trial balance - accounting term)
- {試算|しさん}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (results of trial calculation)
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{試算|しさん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be estimated at ~)

USAGE:
Commonly used in:
- Government policy announcements
- Business planning and budgeting
- Financial analysis
- Project feasibility studies

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{概算|がいさん}→概算：08312_gaisan⟧ (rough estimate)
- ⟦{見積|みつも}り→見積り：04699_mitsumori⟧ (estimate, quotation)
- ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧ (calculation - general)
- ⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧ (exact calculation, settlement)
